specification_metadata.name: Final Execution Specification v3.3.6.4
specification_metadata.description: Comprehensive final specification governing hyperparameter tuning, model refit, freeze audit, test evaluation, and paired cluster bootstrap inference v3.3.6.4 with Gate 1 scope decision verification, profile binding enforcement, Option B fail-closed semantics, fail-closed provenance validation, and exact canonical engine binding.

execution_policy.strict_isolation: Under no circumstances shall *.NOT_FOR_SELECTION.jsonl targets be parsed, opened, or scored prior to completed refit pipeline freeze.
execution_policy.single_pass_guarantee: Final test evaluation is strictly single-pass. No post-test hyperparameter re-selection, candidate switching, or pipeline alteration is permitted.
execution_policy.execution_status: The recommended_16 profile completed model selection, refit, single-pass out-of-time evaluation, and 2,000-iteration paired token-cluster bootstrap inference on 2026-09-15. Public non-row-level outputs are supplied in results/.
execution_policy.cli_exit_semantics: Subcommands exit non-zero (sys.exit(1)) on any BLOCKED_*, FAIL, ERROR, or unhandled exception. Only preflight with PENDING_EXTERNAL_APPROVAL exits 0 with terminal notice.
execution_policy.one_wei_exact_determination: Exact 1-wei trades are strictly determined by integer amount_raw == 1 or losslessly parsed Decimal(price_eth) * 10^18 == 1. Sub-wei (e.g. 0.5 wei), 0, negative values, non-integer wei, NaN, Inf, and missing values fail closed immediately.
execution_policy.custody_failure_lifecycle: Failures during or after clean-slice verification atomically record EVALUATION_FAILED in evaluation_custody.json. Re-evaluation is strictly blocked by BLOCKED_PREVIOUS_EVALUATION_RECORD_EXISTS.
execution_policy.trust_anchor_policy: Self-issued anchors inside the engine package directory or output directory are strictly prohibited. A signed external approval anchor must reside strictly outside both directories and must be passed via --external-anchor-path. It must bind the execution manifest SHA-256, execution profile, and exact approved scope-decisions SHA-256. CLI hash/profile flags are mandatory expectations only and never constitute approval evidence.
execution_policy.exact_integer_wei_policy: Exact 1-wei trades are strictly evaluated by integer amount_raw == 1 or exact Decimal integer wei (price_eth * 10^18 == 1). Sub-wei (e.g. 0.5 wei), 0, negative values, non-integer wei strings, NaN, Inf, and discrepancies between amount_raw and price_eth fail closed with ValueError. Clean sensitivity sample condition is defined as the set-difference result of removing exact 1-wei trades.

specification_metadata.governance_reference: Public Option A decision states are recorded below; the signed approval record is withheld from this public repository.

primary.name: original_v1
primary.description: Primary revision sample using unchanged target generation from target_pipeline_20260909, with uniform transaction weight 1.0. Retains nominal trades; exact 1-wei exclusion is evaluated as a separate sensitivity sample.

sensitivity_exact_one_wei.name: exact_one_wei_sensitivity_v1
sensitivity_exact_one_wei.description: Pre-specified robustness sample strictly excluding the 21 confirmed 1-wei nominal order-price transactions (9 in BAYC, 12 in MAYC) from primary development targets, and excluding 1-wei trades from the baseline market pool (9 in BAYC, 13 in MAYC) as specified in Diagnostic Amendment 20260909.json.

pending_policy_decisions.legacy_7_encoders: Proposed for exclusion due to irremediable lookahead/random-split flaws in legacy audits; awaiting user confirmation.
pending_policy_decisions.dinov3: Proposed for exclusion due to August 2025 release date and HuggingFace gated licensing; awaiting user confirmation.
pending_policy_decisions.background_removal_nobg: Proposed for exclusion from primary pipeline; maintained as auxiliary visual sensitivity.
pending_policy_decisions.trait_probes: Maintained as separate interpretability auxiliary probe; not integrated into pricing prediction pipeline.

clip_native.name: clip_native
clip_native.preprocessing: 224 square resize; 224 center crop does not remove spatial border after square padding

siglip2.name: siglip2
siglip2.preprocessing: 256 square direct resize, official bilinear processor

dinov2_fullframe.name: dinov2_fullframe
dinov2_fullframe.preprocessing: EXIF transpose, RGBA, neutral-gray square padding and straight-alpha composite; bicubic direct 224x224 resize; no center crop

pooling.description: Pre-trained ViT CLS token unnormalized representation

tuning_schedule_2024.description: Expanding prefix internal cross-validation across the three complete calendar quarters of 2024 within the pre-2025 development set.
tuning_schedule_2024.selection_criterion: Minimum pooled validation SSE / n across the 3 internal quarters. Requires all quarter fits to be valid, finite, and converged.

preprocessing.metadata: OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore', drop=None, sparse=False), VarianceThreshold(threshold=0.0) fitted strictly on full development training split. StandardScaler fitted on training split (passthrough for HistGradientBoosting).
preprocessing.vision: Image mask (VarianceThreshold(threshold=0.0)) and StandardScaler fitted strictly on full development training split using token-transaction sample weights.
preprocessing.early_fusion: Concatenation of separately standardized metadata and vision blocks; dynamic dimensionality (dynamic metadata features + native vision dimension).
preprocessing.late_fusion: Convex blend: y_hat = (1 - w*) * y_hat_meta + w* * y_hat_image, where w* in [0.0..1.0] in steps of 0.1 is selected by pooled 2024 Q2-Q4 validation MSE.

persistence.format: joblib archive with zlib compression level 3

PLS.rank_constraint: rank(X_train) >= components; len(model.n_iter_) == components; finite coefficients

LinearSVR_vision_and_early.objective: 0.5 * (||beta||^2 + intercept^2) + C * sum(max(0, |y - (X beta + intercept)| - epsilon)^2)
LinearSVR_vision_and_early.optimization: Newton-Raphson with Armijo backtracking line search
LinearSVR_vision_and_early.stopping_criterion: Stationarity certificate: full primal gradient norm ||grad P(beta)||_2 <= 1e-6

intra_family_rules.ElasticNet: Larger alpha, then larger l1_ratio (sparser model)
intra_family_rules.LinearSVR: Smaller C (stronger regularization), then larger epsilon (wider margin)
intra_family_rules.HistGradientBoosting: Fewer max_leaf_nodes, then larger l2_regularization, then smaller learning_rate
intra_family_rules.LateFusionBlend: Smaller visual weight w (preferring parsimonious metadata baseline over visual augmentation)

bootstrap.resampling_unit: token_id (all transactions belonging to a resampled token are included together into both paired models simultaneously)

confidence_intervals.type: Individual percentile CI for Delta_RMSE and U%
Bonferroni-adjusted joint percentile CI across both collections (BAYC and MAYC)

calendar_block_bootstrap.purpose: Robustness check against market-wide temporal autocorrelations and macro shocks

subgroup_analysis.minimum_support_threshold: At least 50 transactions across at least 30 distinct tokens; below threshold, only descriptive statistics are reported.

BAYC.note: DINOv2 Full-Frame late candidate achieved lowest pooled development MSE with internal weight w=0.0 across D1-D3; reported as selected per Protocol without swapping.

DECISION-01.topic: Primary Confirmatory Inference vs Multi-Encoder Layout
DECISION-01.canonical_summary: Two confirmatory tests (BAYC DINOv2 Full-Frame late_HistGradientBoosting_LinearSVR vs HistGradientBoosting, MAYC CLIP Native late_LinearSVR_ElasticNet vs Ridge) evaluated with Bonferroni two-sided 97.5% CI (alpha=0.025 per collection); all 3 encoders tabulated side-by-side in Table S1 as exploratory benchmarks.

DECISION-02.canonical_summary: Dual reporting framework: (1) Fixed Primary Spec evaluated on clean test trades (set-difference excluding exact 1-wei trades) with zero refitting to assess parameter robustness against micro-penny removal; and (2) Independent Reselection Model refitted on clean development data to assess model selection stability.

DECISION-03.topic: BAYC Original A* Candidate Selection (w=0.0 Collapse)
DECISION-03.canonical_summary: Truthful empirical reporting of DINOv2 Full-Frame candidate (late_HistGradientBoosting_LinearSVR) with historical development weight w=0.0; post-hoc replacement with positive-weight runner-up (SigLIP 2) is strictly prohibited as cherry-picking.

DECISION-04.topic: Scope Exclusions (Legacy 7, DINOv3, NoBG, Trait Probe)
DECISION-04.canonical_summary: Formal exclusion from execution scope: legacy 7 encoders re-extraction (audited limitations disclosed), DINOv3 encoder (external gated licensing barriers and post-protocol release), NoBG universality claim retracted (standardize on full-frame unsegmented images), and trait probe analysis (optional secondary diagnostic decoupled from test unsealing).

execution_profiles.policy: Candidate executable profiles representing different operational scopes; NOT user decisions. Execution requires explicit specification via CLI arguments (--profile and --approved-profile). Implicit defaulting is strictly prohibited.

recommended_16.description: Recommended production profile: 12 confirmatory models + 4 exploratory models covering all 3 vision encoders (SigLIP 2, CLIP Native, DINOv2 Full-Frame) across both collections.

confirmatory_12.description: Minimal confirmatory profile: 12 models (6 BAYC + 6 MAYC) strictly executing primary and sensitivity confirmatory hypotheses.

fixed_spec_1wei_evaluation.description: Fixed primary model specification evaluated directly on exact 1-wei clean test targets (set-difference excluding exact 1-wei trades).

exact_one_wei_definition.criterion: Exact 1-wei trade where integer amount_raw == 1 or losslessly parsed Decimal(price_eth) * 10^18 == 1. Sub-wei (e.g. 0.5 wei), 0, negative values, non-integer wei, NaN, Inf, and missing values fail closed.
exact_one_wei_definition.clean_slice_invariant: sensitivity_rows == primary_rows - exact_1_wei_rows strictly matched by source_row (exact set difference)

fixed_spec_1wei_evaluation.refit_policy: Zero calls to .fit() or refitting; pre-fitted original_v1 bundles are loaded and invoked directly via .predict().
